title: New speech and multimodal models
summary:
New speech and multimodal models arrived alongside clearer community-model inputs and broader configurable fallback routing.

Kokoro 82M adds text-to-speech with 54 voices across eight languages. Inkling Small adds text output from text, image, or audio input, with tools, reasoning, and a large context window. The `deepseek` route now uses the DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 checkpoint.

A Quest contribution lets community model owners declare input modalities in the model dialog, API, or CLI. Those declarations appear in the catalog, and image endpoints that accept images advertise the edits route. A separate change added another eligible community-model publisher.

Team changes unified registry and community fallback routing for text, image, and video, then extended configured fallbacks to model-selecting audio routes, embeddings, and 3D generation. Community developers can designate their own active private models as fallbacks for public models. The registry changes add no fallback pairs.

daily.title: Kokoro speech joins the API
daily.text: Generate speech with `kokoro-82m`: 54 voices across eight languages, with MP3, Opus, FLAC, WAV, and PCM output. [Browse Kokoro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kokoro-82m).

daily.title: Inkling Small joins the models
daily.text: Use `inkling` for reasoning and tool-capable text responses with text, image, or audio input. Image and audio inputs are supported separately, not in the same request. [Browse Inkling](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=inkling).

daily.title: DeepSeek Flash gets 0731
daily.text: `deepseek` and its existing aliases now route to the DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 checkpoint. [Browse DeepSeek](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek).

daily.title: Declare community model inputs
daily.text: Community model owners can specify accepted input types in the model dialog, API `inputModalities` field, or CLI `--input-modalities` option. Image endpoints that declare image input also advertise `/v1/images/edits`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Configure fallbacks across modalities
daily.text: Model owners can configure ordered fallback targets for retryable upstream failures across text, image, video, model-selecting audio, embeddings, and 3D requests. Registry support adds no fallback pairs by default. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
